audit.whatIsWrong: Both layers give Gnar the first-item and two-item rows. The packet gives both to Karma, and the page's own text agrees with the packet: whys[5] ends 'the first-item lane belongs to her' and whys[6] has her kiting a plateaued Gnar. Rows 1-5 already match.
audit.why: Karma out-ranges Mini Gnar and Gnar's late identity here is teamfight engage, not dueling — the page's late paragraph says exactly that.
audit.corrected: Rows 6 and 7 flipped as one group in both layers with ratings moved to match.

audit.why: Four spikes present and real: Lvl 2 Hyper trade, Lvl 6 Rage window, first-item Mantra poke, late kiting. Range detail added to spikes[2].
audit.corrected: Inner Flame's 950 range and Inspire named in spikes[2].

audit.whatIsWrong: The page claims Focused Resolve 'breaks if you LoS / outrange it' — Riot's text supports breaking it by distance but says nothing about line of sight. No cooldowns appear anywhere, and the page treats Mantra as something that shows up around first item when Riot states it is available at level 1 and costs no skill point.
audit.why: Three consequences. The break is a range check at 675, so the instruction is to walk out, not to hide behind terrain. Focused Resolve is 12s flat at every rank, so there is no rank-up window to wait for. And because Mantra is live from level 1 on a 40s cooldown — shortened further every time her damaging abilities land — there is never a phase of the lane where the empowered poke simply does not exist, which is the opposite of what the current text implies.
audit.corrected: Range-break and 12s written into the do's, cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions; Mantra's level-1 availability and 40s cooldown written into the cooldown block and Key Ability Interactions; Grievous Wounds tied to the Mantra-W heal in itemization.
sources: enemyKit Karma W cd 12, range 675, text
enemyKit Karma R cd 40/38/36/34 and text 'available at level 1 and does not require a skill point'

audit.whatIsWrong: Itemization never mentions anti-heal against a champion whose Mantra-W heals her.
audit.why: Riot's W Mantra bonus explicitly heals Karma while extending the root, so extended trades turn on Grievous Wounds timing.
sources: enemyKit Karma W heal flag and Mantra Bonus text

edits.before: Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Her tether roots on a 12s cooldown unless you break it by leaving 675 range.

edits.before: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — Her root tether — breaks if you LoS / outrange it. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Karma Focused Resolve: matchup-defining — 12s flat, and the root only lands if you fail to break the 675-range tether. - Mantra: 40s at rank 1 and live from level 1 with no point spent. - Your ultimate: kill windows only.

edits.after: Focused Resolve (12s) roots unless you break the 675-range tether. Mantra is live from level 1 — her poke has no off period.

edits.after: Mantra-Q at 950 range plus her Inspire shield out-range and out-sustain your Mini harass — the lane tilts to her here.

notes: No mirror audit exists for karma__gnar; when it is written, restate inverted: Level 1 even, Levels 2-3 Gnar's, Levels 4-5 and 6 decided by Gnar's Rage bar, both item stages Karma's. Focused Resolve is broken by distance (675), not by line of sight — the previous LoS claim was not supported by any local file and I removed rather than reworded it. Mantra being available from level 1 without a skill point is stated outright in Riot's R text and contradicts the page's framing of mantra-Q as a first-item arrival; I corrected the cooldown block and interactions line but left the early/mid/late paragraphs alone rather than risk the length band.
